description: This file defines an abstract class 'VersionGenerator' which provides a framework for generating version information, including version code and version name, based on provided generation data.

classes.name: VersionGenerator
classes.description: An abstract class that serves as a base for generating version information, requiring subclasses to implement environment validation and version code retrieval.

methods.name: isValidForEnvironment
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the version generator is valid for the current environment.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Creates a VersionData object using the version code and name derived from generation data.

methods.name: getVersionCode
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the version code based on generation data.

methods.name: getVersionName
methods.description: Generates a version name string based on major, minor, and patch offset from generation data.
